arxiv-2108-13791.title: On the Cantor set and the Cantor-Lebesgue functions Thanks: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 26A03 Secondary 26A30 Thanks: Key words and phrases: Cantor set, perfect sets, nowhere dense sets, uncountable sets, fractal sets, Cantor-Lebesgue function, Lebesgue’s space filling curves.
arxiv-2108-13791.creator: Lihang Liu, Wilfredo O. Urbina
arxiv-2108-13791.description: Abstract . The ternary Cantor set 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , constructed by George Cantor in 1883, is the best known example of a perfect nowhere-dense set in the real line. The present article we study the basic properties 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and also study in detail the ternary expansion characterization 𝒞 \mathcal{C} .

arxiv-2110-04046.title: Local orthogonal maps and rigidity of holomorphic mappings between real hyperquadrics
arxiv-2110-04046.creator: Yun Gao, Sui-Chung Ng
arxiv-2110-04046.description: Abstract We introduced a new coordinate-free approach to study the Cauchy-Riemann (CR) maps between the real hyperquadrics in the complex projective space. The central theme is based on a notion of orthogonality on the projective space induced by the Hermitian structure defining the hyperquadrics.

arxiv-2111-07972.title: A Review of the System-Intrinsic Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics in Extended Space (MNEQT) with Applications
arxiv-2111-07972.creator: P.D. Gujrati, 1,2
arxiv-2111-07972.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by P.D. Gujrati, 1,2. The review deals with a novel approach (MNEQT) to nonequilibrium thermodynamics (NEQT) that is based on the concept of internal equilibrium (IEQ) in an enlarged state space 𝔖 𝐙 \mathfrak{S}_{\mathbf{Z}} involving internal variables as additional state variables . The IEQ macrostates are unique in 𝔖 𝐙 \mathfrak{S}_{\mathbf{Z}} and have no memory just as EQ macrostates are in the EQ state space 𝔖 𝐗 ⊂ 𝔖 𝐙 \mathfrak{S}_{\mathbf{X}}\subset\mathfrak{S}_{\mathbf{Z}} .

arxiv-2207-01802.title: Backend Ensemble for Speaker Verification and Spoofing Countermeasure
arxiv-2207-01802.creator: Li Zhang, Yue Li, Huan Zhao, Qing Wang, Lei Xie
arxiv-2207-01802.description: Abstract This paper describes the NPU system submitted to Spoofing Aware Speaker Verification Challenge 2022. We particularly focus on the backend ensemble for speaker verification and spoofing countermeasure from three aspects. arxiv-2302-08957.title: Like a Good Nearest Neighbor: Practical Content Moderation and Text Classification
arxiv-2302-08957.creator: Luke Bates, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2302-08957.description: Abstract Few-shot text classification systems have impressive capabilities but are infeasible to deploy and use reliably due to their dependence on prompting and billion-parameter language models. SetFit ( Tunstall et al. 2022 ) is a recent, practical approach that fine-tunes a Sentence Transformer under a contrastive learning paradigm and achieves similar results to more unwieldy systems.

arxiv-2511-08890.title: Mobile chemical cage: Revealing the origin of anomalous lithium diffusion in liquid L ​ i 17 ​ P ​ b 83 Li_{17}Pb_{83} alloy
arxiv-2511-08890.creator: Sensen Lin, Yang Gao, Yongheng Lu, Yongkuan Zhang, Yiqiang Sun
arxiv-2511-08890.description: Abstract The high-temperature performance of liquid L ​ i 17 ​ P ​ b 83 Li_{17}Pb_{83} , a key fusion reactor material, is governed by its atomic-scale dynamics. Using ab initio molecular dynamics, we discover that lithium diffusion is not free but confined within cages formed by lead atoms, a phenomenon we term the chemical cage effect.

pmc-10620831.creator: Kai Zheng, Siyu Chen, Zhe Ren, Yifei Wang
pmc-10620831.description: Protein arginine methyltransferase (PRMT)-mediated arginine methylation is an important post-transcriptional modification that regulates various cellular processes including epigenetic gene regulation, genome stability maintenance, RNA metabolism, and stress-responsive signal transduction. The varying substrates and biological functions of arginine methylation in cancer and neurological diseases have been extensively discussed, providing a rationale for targeting PRMTs in clinical applications.

pmc-13503816.creator: Lihui Xia, Lu Zhao, Junjie Wang
pmc-13503816.description: Object detectors have been widely deployed in safety-critical applications such as surveillance, autonomous driving, and industrial vision.
